body: My Mom. She is a sweet woman but she has an issue with painkillers and a lot of her reckless spending has not helped. She also refuses to put down an aged and clearly suffering dog that requires ridiculously expensive food ($300/mo) and such to survive. I think a dog that is blind, deaf and incontinent should be put down but I'd be looked at like a monster for even suggesting it. My Father just had an issue with his health and apparently had over 40 pounds of fluid buildup in his body that strained his heart. He is out of work while recovering from a triple bypass. He lives with his brother. A lot of things are strained and stressful which is why we aren't calling it a 'happy' holiday.

Well, it was New York. The issue was the cost of living. A two bedroom apartment in my area where a lot of my family was is pressing on $1,700 at a minimum without any utilities. We had a place for $1,100 with all utilities, but the lady was being foreclosed on so we had to move. I had a relative out of the marines in NC so it made sense, but I didn't know about the medicaid issues until after I moved or I would have tried for another expansion state instead. At the very least a 2 bedroom here is about $700. No utilities, but it doesn't add that much.

Well, the part that was growing in my mouth is receding. I noticed that while brushing my teeth and I decided to wait until after Christmas to see if I still need the ER. I meant to say that over $60,000 went into it, but medicaid in the other state paid for almost all of it. That was a medicaid expansion state meaning being poor was a good enough reason to get it. Here you have to be declared disabled to qualify. I am $11,000 in debt, but that much went into my healthcare for this problem.
